coverage.name: scope uses exact native window role and route without audio-context readiness
diagnostics expose only scope, restored and loadStatus and unregister safely
factory is self-contained in a separate VM
wrapper seed script writes only a missing key and validates before generation
missing saved key preserves upstream fit without initial writes
seed is write-once and uses whitelisted fields only
restore follows fit and preserves all seven camera fields
change snapshots real target, debounces writes, and end flushes
already captured changes flush to the old key after props change
model switching restores separate views and invalidates stale tickets
same source with a new ID is a different lifecycle
preview cannot overwrite stage even for the same model ID
bad JSON or mismatched ID falls back to fit without overwriting
invalid finite ranges and degenerate camera geometry are rejected
storage denial leaves rendering and interaction usable
ID-less upstream models can load but never persist
not-loaded and not-fitted states cannot save or restore
unmount flushes the last captured view and removes listeners
current real compiled asset patches in memory and passes Node ESM syntax
patch is idempotent without touching unrelated regions
changed upstream anchor fails closed
duplicate MMD region and partial markers fail closed
real compiled setup fits then restores seeded stage view
compiled main window without an audio context still restores stage and exposes safe diagnostics
compiled controlled v-model prop lag cannot skip camera restoration
compiled async loader discards a stale result before scene ownership
compiled animation init cannot fit or restore after model switch
compiled preview uses its own scope and FOV changes save there
compiled stale rejection does not dispose the new model
compiled model with no saved view uses global fit FOV instead of previous restored FOV
compiled model without an ID still mounts using upstream fit
actual bundled Vue controlled useModel setter does not immediately update its getter
frozen V1 loses restoration under the reproduced controlled-model timing
actual bundled OrbitControls restores pose and emits no initial write
actual Orbit interaction saves real target and restores identical projection
actual Orbit residual damping cannot overwrite a newly restored model
apply and repeat apply work only on a copied fixture
ambiguous asset directory fails without modifying either candidate
V1 without a matching original backup fails without changing the installed asset
V1 upgrade checks the entire old patch by exact replay and preserves originals
modified V1 code cannot be silently replaced even with an original backup

limits: Compiled lifecycle uses a synthetic engine VM; actual bundled Vue controlled-model timing and Three/OrbitControls are separately tested without a native window or GPU.
Native restart, exact current closeup seed, and mouse drag/restart persistence require owner integration.
